name: Tokyo Imperial Palace grounds tour
statusNote: Read from the Imperial Household Agency's official visit application site.
howToBuy: Apply on the Imperial Household Agency's visit website, which has an English version. The tour is free.
The whole month opens at 05:00 Japan time on the 1st of the month before. For example, December tours open on November 1.
Online applications close at 23:59 four days before the tour.
Bring your passport on the day. The name must match your application.
rulesToKnow: 300 same-day places per tour are given out at the gate, first come, first served, until they run out.
The Imperial Palace East Gardens are a different area and need no booking.

soldOut.label: Get a same-day place at the gate: 300 per tour, first come, first served
Guided walks around the Imperial Palace and its gardens on Klook

faq.q: When can I book the Imperial Palace tour?
faq.a: At 05:00 Japan time on the 1st of the month before your visit. Bookings close at 23:59 four days before the tour.

faq.q: Can I join the Imperial Palace tour without booking?
faq.a: Yes, if places are left. 300 same-day places per tour are handed out at the gate, first come, first served.

sources.quote: 参観希望日の前月の1日の午前5時～希望日の4日前23時59分まで
先着順（300名）に整理券を配布し、満員となり次第受付終了。
